text: ぜひ　みに　いきたいが　やっぱり　わしは　ジジイ　むりは　できん！

structure.jp: ぜひ　みに　いきたいが
structure.en: I'd love to go see, but

structure.jp: やっぱり　わしは　ジジイ
structure.en: after all I'm an old man

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: に after a verb stem says the purpose of going. みに　いきたい = 'want to go to see'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい after a verb stem means 'want to do'. いきたい = 'want to go'.
